story1.title: Study where the world comes together
story1.body: Nadoumi works with universities across China, Malaysia and beyond. Browse each institution’s profile, campus, rankings and the programmes it offers before you commit.

story2.title: Built around your profile
story2.body: Add your details, education history and documents once. Nadoumi reuses them for every application, and each submission is kept as a historical record — later profile edits never rewrite it.

journey.title: Your journey with Nadoumi
journey.description: From your first application fee to your admission documents — here is what to expect.
journey.s1b: Start your application and settle the application fee to begin processing.
journey.s2b: Nadoumi checks your profile and documents against the opportunity’s requirements.
journey.s3b: Your case is matched and submitted to the university.
journey.s4b: The university confirms your place and issues your admission letter.
journey.s5b: Settle the remaining project and service fees to move to enrolment.
journey.s6b: Your visa documentation (JW202 / JW201) is prepared and released.
journey.s7b: Your admission and visa documents are couriered to you.
journey.s8b: You’re ready to travel and enrol. Nadoumi stays available through arrival.

cta.title: Start your international education with Nadoumi
cta.body: Create a free profile, explore your options, and apply with a team that runs the whole process.

about.title: About Nadoumi
about.subtitle: An international education platform.
about.body: Nadoumi connects students with universities, programmes and scholarships across China, Malaysia and other destinations, and supports them through the whole application lifecycle — profile, documents, submission, decisions and enrolment.
about.whoBody: Students applying to study abroad, and the parents, relatives or advisers who help them — an account holder can manage applications for more than one student.
about.destinationsBody: Nadoumi works with partner universities in China, Malaysia and other countries, and keeps a wider catalogue of institutions students can explore.
about.lc2: Discover programmes and scholarships that fit.
about.lc3: Submit an application — your details are captured as they were at that moment.
about.lc4: Provide and track the documents each opportunity requires.
about.lc5: Receive decisions and prepare for enrolment.
about.approachBody: Public information about universities, programmes and scholarships is kept separate from internal partner and operational data. Students see what is relevant to them; everything else stays behind staff authorisation.

legal.privacyIntro: This page explains what personal data Nadoumi collects and how it is used.
legal.privacyBody: Nadoumi processes the information you provide to build your applicant profile and submit applications on your behalf. Data is stored securely and shared only with the universities and partners involved in your applications.
legal.termsIntro: These terms govern your use of the Nadoumi platform.
legal.termsBody: By creating an account you agree to provide accurate information and to use the platform only for legitimate education applications. Nadoumi may update these terms; material changes will be notified.
legal.contactLine: Questions? Reach us via the contact page.
